settings.label: Application Client ID
settings.help: Public OAuth application identifier. Required for Connect with; manual tokens can be entered without it.

settings.label: Video ID override (optional)
settings.help: Leave empty to follow your active broadcasts automatically. If several are live, choose one below. Enter a video ID only to pin a specific broadcast.

authentication.help: Enable YouTube Data API v3. Native: use a Desktop OAuth client with PKCE; enter its application secret in local Application setup. Browser: use a Web OAuth client with this page origin authorized; sign-in uses Google Identity Services without an application secret. Sending requires youtube.force-ssl; read-only uses youtube.readonly.

native.instructions: Select a Cloud project and enable YouTube Data API v3. Configure the OAuth consent screen and add your account as a test user while the app is in Testing. Create a Desktop app OAuth client. Copy its Client ID into Application Client ID above Connect. PKCE uses a temporary loopback redirect; do not create a Web client or a hosted redirect for native sign-in. Copy its application secret into the local Application secret field; it stays on this device. A read-only connection needs youtube.readonly; sending chat needs youtube.force-ssl.

browser.instructions: Select a Cloud project, enable YouTube Data API v3, configure OAuth consent and add test users while in Testing. Create a Web application OAuth client. Add the exact origin below to Authorized JavaScript origins and copy its Client ID into Application Client ID above Connect. Google Identity Services opens a popup; no redirect URI or application secret is used for this token flow. Allow popups. A read-only connection needs youtube.readonly; sending chat needs youtube.force-ssl.

chat_presentation.help: Chat for the selected live broadcast. Sending uses the authorized channel and is subject to live chat permissions and restrictions.
